releaseNotes: My Diary 1.0.220 APK is unchanged. Web Update 469 adds separate position and size settings for the Diary heading Me and × buttons through the Me menu. Phone test for Web 469 is pending.
webReleaseNotes: My Diary Web Update 469: adds Button Set Karein inside the Me menu. Me and × heading buttons can be selected separately, dragged to a new position, resized, and saved on the phone. Reset restores the original position and size. Recently Deleted fullscreen keeps its original × position and size. APK 1.0.220 is unchanged.
